text_en: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
text_cn: 天主祝福诺厄和他的儿子们说：“你们要滋生繁殖，充满大地。

text_en: The fear and dread of you shall rest on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the air, on everything that creeps on the ground, and on all the fish of the sea; into your hand they are delivered.
text_cn: 地上的各种野兽，天空的各种飞鸟，地上的各种爬虫和水中的各种游鱼，都要对你们表示惊恐畏惧：这一切都已交在你们手中。

text_en: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you; and just as I gave you the green plants, I give you everything.
text_cn: 凡有生命的动物，都可作你们的食物；我将这一切赐给你们，有如以前赐给你们蔬菜一样；

text_en: Only, you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.
text_cn: 凡有生命，带血的肉，你们不可吃；

text_en: For your own lifeblood I will surely require a reckoning: from every animal I will require it and from human beings, each one for the blood of another, I will require a reckoning for human life.
text_cn: 并且，我要追讨害你们生命的血债：向一切野兽追讨，向人，向为弟兄的人，追讨人命。

text_en: Whoever sheds the blood of a human, by a human shall that person’s blood be shed; for in his own image God made humankind.
text_cn: 凡流人血的，他的血也要为人所流，因为人是照天主的肖像造的。

text_en: And you, be fruitful and multiply, abound on the earth and multiply in it. ”
text_cn: 你们要生育繁殖，在地上滋生繁衍。”

text_en: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him,
text_cn: 天主对诺厄和他的儿子们说：

text_en: “As for me, I am establishing my covenant with you and your descendants after you,
text_cn: “看，我现在与你们和你们未来的后裔立约，

text_en: and with every living creature that is with you, the birds, the domestic animals, and every animal of the earth with you, as many as came out of the ark.
text_cn: 并与同你们在一起的一切生物：飞鸟、牲畜和一切地上野兽，即凡由方舟出来的一切地上生物立约。

text_en: I establish my covenant with you, that never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of a flood, and never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth. ”
text_cn: 我与你们立约：凡有血肉的，以后决不再受洪水湮(yān)灭，再没有洪水来毁灭大地。”

text_en: God said, “This is the sign of the covenant that I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for all future generations:
text_cn: 天主说：“这是我在我与你们以及同你们在一起的一切生物之间，立约的永远标记：

text_en: I have set my bow in the clouds, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
text_cn: 我把虹霓放在云间，作我与大地之间立约的标记。

text_en: When I bring clouds over the earth and the bow is seen in the clouds,
text_cn: 几时我兴云遮盖大地，云中要出现虹霓，

text_en: I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.
text_cn: 那时我便想起我与你们以及各种属血肉的生物之间所立的盟约：这样水就不会再成为洪水，毁灭一切血肉的生物。

text_en: When the bow is in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth. ”
text_cn: 几时虹霓在云间出现，我一看见，就想起在天主与地上各种属血肉的生物之间所立的永远盟约。”

text_en: God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth. ”
text_cn: 天主对诺厄说：“这就是我在我与地上一切有血肉的生物之间，所立的盟约的标记。”

text_en: The sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham was the father of Canaan.
text_cn: 诺厄的儿子由方舟出来的，有闪、含、和耶斐特。含是客纳罕的父亲。

text_en: These three were the sons of Noah; and from these the whole earth was peopled.
text_cn: 这三人是诺厄的儿子；人类就由这三人分布天下。

text_en: Noah, a man of the soil, was the first to plant a vineyard.
text_cn: 诺厄原是农夫，遂开始种植葡萄园。

text_en: He drank some of the wine and became drunk, and he lay uncovered in his tent.
text_cn: 一天他喝酒喝醉了，就在自己的帐幕内脱去了衣服。

text_en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
text_cn: 客纳罕的父亲含看见了父亲赤身露体，遂去告诉外面的两个兄弟。

text_en: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
text_cn: 闪和耶斐特二人于是拿了件外衣，搭在肩上，倒退着走进去，盖上父亲的裸体。他们的脸背着，没有看见父亲的裸体。

text_en: When Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his youngest son had done to him,
text_cn: 诺厄醒了后，知道了小儿对他作的事，

text_en: he said, “Cursed be Canaan; lowest of slaves shall he be to his brothers. ”
text_cn: 就说：“客纳罕是可咒骂的，给兄弟当最下贱的奴隶。”

text_en: He also said, “Blessed by the Lord my God be Shem; and let Canaan be his slave.
text_cn: 又说：“上主，闪的天主，应受赞美，客纳罕应作他的奴隶。

text_en: May God make space for Japheth, and let him live in the tents of Shem; and let Canaan be his slave. ”
text_cn: 愿天主扩展耶斐特，使他住在闪的帐幕内；客纳罕应作他的奴隶。”

text_en: After the flood Noah lived three hundred fifty years.
text_cn: 洪水以后，诺厄又活了三百五十年。

text_en: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years; and he died.
text_cn: 诺厄共活了九百五十岁死了。
